question: What are X-rays also known as?
solution:
The correct answer is __**W.Röntgen** **rays.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **X-rays** were discovered by **W.C. Röntgen **in December **1895.**
 
• Following **seven weeks** of diligent **research** into the characteristics of this **novel form **of radiation that could pass through **screens** of appreciable **thickness**.
 
• He **gave** them the term **"X-rays**" to emphasize that it was unclear&
